\caption{Data-treatment decisions of the pipeline, judged by a fixed panel of three pre-specified models (LR: logistic on chiral bins; GBM: LightGBM on summary features; MR: MiniRocket + ridge). Options: how many alternatives were tested, on which models. Evidence: paired leave-one-person-out accuracy differences against the current default (20 persons; 95\% person-bootstrap CIs; q: Benjamini-Hochberg over the 96 option comparisons); nominal: the CI excludes 0 but q does not pass. Gain forgone at most: the largest upper CI bound of any option, i.e. the most the default could be beaten by. Rule (pre-specified): change a default only if one option is better for at least two panel models and worse for none; an option run on one model cannot meet it.}
